# HirePilotX

> HirePilotX is an applicant tracking system (ATS) for recruiting agencies: manage clients, jobs, candidates, submissions and interviews from one workspace.

The app is an authenticated workspace; the pages below are the public entry points. All other screens require a signed-in session.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to your agency workspace
- [Create account](/create-account): Start a workspace with a 14-day free trial
- [Verify email](/verify): Confirm the work email address a workspace was created with

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of HirePilotX
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How HirePilotX handles personal data
